workbookRegression.beforeObservation: 201 upload produced ready/new with Status:null because blank self-closing F2 swallowed populated G2
workbookRegression.afterObservation: Same bytes produce invalid/UNRECOGNIZED_STATUS with Prototype Review; UI mapping then commit creates one card

harnessAttempts.detail: Sandbox EPERM connecting to disposable loopback PostgreSQL; no product assertions.

harnessAttempts.classification: harness assumptions and separately reproduced product bug
harnessAttempts.detail: Initial expected finalize201 instead of200; wrong menu/label selectors; wrong fixture SQL column/table names; missing synthetic cursor key. Original official-template Status loss was independently reproduced in03.

harnessAttempts.classification: partial diagnostic plus harness route crash
harnessAttempts.detail: Image, project/board creation, mention/inbox and baseline task/activity assertions passed; original official workbook Status loss reproduced. Invitation route interceptor threw Route already handled before final cleanup. Only partial checkpoint retained; orphan Next terminated and exact own schema removed via batch-ID-matched cleanup.

harnessAttempts.classification: six passed groups, two harness interaction assumptions
harnessAttempts.detail: Full-name mention text sometimes no longer acts as an active picker query; use partial @Syn. Playwright uncheck expects immediate checked-state change while real checkbox waits for async API; replace with click then await successful DELETE and refreshed data. Both corrected in05.

cleanup.normalRuns: helper close drops only each created schema; all browser contexts and Next/API servers stopped

limits: 11 grouped flows are actual asserted diagnostic scope; no claim that all98 features or74 UI features passed.

Runs span a moving checkout. Selected relevant source files are hashed before/after each complete run; this is not the complete source manifest required by the review gate. Fresh frozen independent review remains required.
Original workbook regression fixed by root after03. Expanded-empty-cell diagnostic workaround04 is superseded by exact-byte original fixture06.

Image storage is MemoryStorageDriver with real Sharp verification and authenticated HTTP; no R2 durability, CDN, bucket policy, deployed runtime, Google identity, real email delivery or hosted UAT tested.
Import retention invokes actual cleanup service with synthetic +31-minute asOfDate; proves cleanup and retained receipt effects, not production scheduler timing.

Task depth uses61 synthetic assigned cards across two selected-project boards plus one assigned sentinel in another project; seed mutations use actual fixture API, assignment rows are direct synthetic SQL.
Column reorder received actual200; the harness did not separately assert its intermediate final database position before subsequent deletion.
Invitation acceptance/token-link navigation is not covered. No invitation link screenshot, cookie export, bearer, browser storage/auth state, or raw request/error body persisted.
External browser HTTP blocked; recorded external-origin set was empty. This is browser request evidence, not a general machine zero-egress claim.
No product files, contracts, migrations or shared scripts edited by this tester; no feature handoff/checklist approval or numerical score assigned.
